core.title: Square American Cylinder Patio Door Entry Trim Set With A Classic Beaded Lever, Omnia 72946ACA-US26

text.description_html:
Omnia 72946ACAUS26, Solid Brass Patio Door Entry Trim Set In Polished Chrome Finish

The timeless square shape of Omnia's 72000 series multipoint trim combines perfectly with the classic beaded lever. These solid brass leversets are for use with American Cylinder Above Lever (american profile lock cylinder above the door lever) type multipoint mortise locksets commonly found on swinging patio doors.

The Thru-Bolts are fixed at 8-1/2" center to center and can not be modified. In some cases new thru-bolting holes must be drilled in your door.

These multipoint trim sets are intended to replace the original trim from G-U, Eagle, BiltBest, Hurd and others. The Lock to Lever distance is 3-5/8" (92 mm).

Also Available: Arched Patio Door Trim with American Cylinder Below the lever and with European Cylinder

Specifications: for Omnia 72000ACA Multipoint Trim Sets

  • Lock to Lever Spacing: 3-5/8" (92 mm) Center to Center
  • Thru-Bolt Hole Spacing: 8-1/2" (216 mm) Center to Center
  • Plate Height: 9-13/16" (250 mm)
  • Plate Width: 2" (50 mm)
  • Plate Projection: 1/2" (12.5 mm)
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
